# COFA — Common Operation Framework for Agent

> A platform-agnostic maturity layer. Takes a bare agent platform, hosted or self-run, open or closed
> source, and gives it the four things that normally take weeks to build: durable memory, a policy
> gate, peer messaging, and restart continuity.

Installing an agent is easy. Maturing it is what costs weeks. Each component here is self-contained,
independently installable, and documented with what to change, how to verify it works, and how to
roll back. You may only need one of them.

Canonical source: https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa

## Skills

- [cofa-continuity](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/skills/cofa-continuity/SKILL.md): checkpoint and resume; a written file becomes ground truth after a restart.
- [cofa-long-term-memory](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/skills/cofa-long-term-memory/SKILL.md): local PostgreSQL fact store, namespaced per agent, no cloud dependency.
- [cofa-policy-cel](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/skills/cofa-policy-cel/SKILL.md): CEL policy-as-code evaluated before actions, with a hardened rule baseline.
- [cofa-a2a-mesh](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/skills/cofa-a2a-mesh/SKILL.md): agent-to-agent task exchange over HTTP with exit codes that separate transport from task outcomes.

## Components

- [long-term-memory](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/long-term-memory/README.md): memory client, schema, verification script.
- [policy-cel](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/policy-cel/README.md): evaluator, sample rules, verification script.
- [a2a-mesh](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/a2a-mesh/README.md): client, peer config, verification script.
- [continuity](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/continuity/README.md): checkpoint client, resume convention.

- [README](https://github.com/curiositygarage/cofa/blob/main/README.md): what each component gives you and how to navigate.

## Requirements

PostgreSQL 14+ for memory, Python 3.9+ standard library for every shipped client. Nothing else is
downloaded at install time, and no Node.js client ships — `lib/a2a_client.py` is the only one.

## Optional

- Environment overrides and config fields are documented per component in its `README.md`.
- `checks/verify.sh` in each component is the acceptance test to run before trusting an install.
